newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill raises UK property sector.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill raises UK property sector.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has raised its stance on the UK property sector to "overweight" as part of a review of the industry, market sources said on Thursday.
The brokerage's preferred stocks were British Land Plc, Hammerson Plc, Great Portland Estates Plc, Hemingway Properties Plc and Slough Estates Plc, the sources said.

Merrill also raised its net asset value estimates for fiscal 1998 and said it expected a rent and yield improvement of some 10 percent that year, the sources added. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
